target_prompts.description: Syria: Country in the Middle East, Leonardo DiCaprio: American actor, Samsung: South Korean multinational major appliance and consumer electronics corporation, x

_notes: Port of PAIR-code/interpretability patchscopes_utils: a forward hook on decoder layer l overwrites the hidden state at the placeholder (last) position of the target prompt with scale * vector; in generation mode the hook only fires on the prefill pass (sequence length > 1).
Target prompts are the official ones: the identity prompt reads the next-token distribution (top_k tokens), the entity-description prompt generates gen_tokens greedily.
Vectors come from exp/04 outputs/acts (neutral prompt set): per-prompt vectors at six positions, and mean vectors over prompts for nine poolings.

raw: each model's own per-prompt vector patched into the model itself at scale 1. raw_mean: the mean over prompts, scale sweep. diff_mean: mean(h_MO) - mean(h_ref) patched into the reference model, scale sweep. diff_prompt: per-prompt h_MO - h_ref into the reference model at three scales.
The scale sweep is the diffing-toolkit auto-patchscope grid: 0.5..2.0 in 16 steps, 3/4/5/10/20, and 10 points from 20 to 200 (30 unique values).

References per organism: clean parent (SFT base for integrated_dpo, clean DPO otherwise), own surrogate, cross-family unmixed_fd MO (the exp/03 cross). The reference is also the model patched into (the auditor's model).
